title: Much smaller than the pic
text:
Much smaller than the pic. Ok...weird..
The adhesion is ok..so far nothing has fell off..HOWEVER, the quality is not the greatest. Mirror finish is nice once you peel off protective covers. Extremely tedious to install . Super small, nothing like the pictrue at all. About the size of 2 8×10s depending on placement..cute, not elegant..just ok
